judge.rationale: The candidate produces zero production code changes, only adding a `.lore/dod.md` planning document and a single test file (`src/transport/ws/list-conversations.acceptance.test.ts`). Because `validateMessage` is never actually modified to support `list_conversations`, the validation tests in the added test file will immediately fail. Furthermore, the other two test blocks in that file are trivial mocks asserting properties on local object/string literals rather than exercising any engine code. None of the message types, validation logic, handler routing, config options, error codes, docs, or specs requested by the issue were implemented.
